affected_subject.reason: Identifies FastAccessVault.rebalanceFunds() as the affected function/component.

trigger_or_action.reason: Any address can call the permissionless rebalanceFunds(), e.g. after large mints or spamming after every mint.

direct_effect.reason: Caller force-drains excess liquidity to the custodian, leaving only the target buffer and forcing redemptions onto the slow path, disabling fast redemption.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected-vs-actual relation: random EOAs should not move protocol liquidity (least privilege), and users expect instant redemptions but instead wait minutes/hours.

summary: Fragments identify the permissionless FastAccessVault.rebalanceFunds(), its callability by any address, the resulting liquidity drain and fast-redemption DoS, and the violated least-privilege/expected-instant-redemption relation.
